threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think Buses run on time. That blank look when you suggest a Tube is an option? Classic rookie mistake.
Last night on the 3 bus, a bloke serenaded the whole upper deck with 90s R&B. Everyone pretended to ignore it, but we were totally vibing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a family having a picnic on the street during the bus strike, kids playing while the adults sipped coffee on the curb. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a 'knick-knack' shop selling vintage postcards and random collectibles tucked behind an old club. It's like a treasure hunt!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local when they casually complain about the never-ending BART delays but still find a way to make it to their favorite taco truck.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 today just as a guy in a tiger onesie boarded, holding a saxophone. Only in the Tenderloin could that pass as typical.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every street performer is a local artist, but many are just passing through for tips, especially around the plaça.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still checking their phones for the next metro instead of just following the crowd to the nearest station.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think getting a coffee means waiting in a queue at the barista instead of knowing the right spot for a takeaway flat white.
Last night on the 36, a guy insisted the driver was a secret agent. He showed everyone his 'evidence'—a half-eaten sausage roll. Classic Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw someone setting up a barbershop in a bus stop shelter; only in Neukölln do you find creativity in the mundane.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings—nothing like dancing in a former factory at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they navigate a BART delay—no whining, just immediately checking the bus schedule and heading for tacos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 at Civic Center today, and a guy started reciting poetry to the passengers. Muni's theater in transit never fails.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just all about the gaudí, but they miss out on the hidden plazas where locals sip vermut and share stories.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking photos of every little detail in Plaça del Sol, oblivious to the usual sunbathers giving them sideways glances.
